A '''forearm plate''' was a type of large, chrome [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlet]] worn over an individual's [[Limb/Legends|forearm]] as [[Armor/Legends|protection]]. [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], on occasion, wore forearm plates on both arms.
